answer: Reputation decay is a gym membership you stop using: it lapses. Every identity starts at 100 points; after 2 idle epochs it loses 8 per epoch, below 60 it loses rewards and voting weight. Real work adds 6 back, up to 100. A forger stockpiling 1,000 identities pays 3,000 units per epoch to keep them. An ember untended dies, and a karst cave drips on. Idle clones spiral down 8 points; decay turns hoarding into a subscription, not an asset.
